title: 1stDibs to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference
summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, announced today that CEO David Rosenblatt and CPO CMO Bradford Shellhammer will present at the Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference in Chicago on Wednesday, August 26 at 10:15 AM ET. A live webcast and replay of the presentation will be available on the company's Investor Relations website ( investors.1stdibs.com ). About 1stDibs 1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for connecting design lovers with highly coveted sellers and makers of vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, jewelry, watches and fashion. Investor Relations Contact: Kevin LaBuz, Head of Investor Relations Corporate Development investors@1stDibs.com Source: 1stdibs.com, Inc.
